- We'll have a third-party consultant (Marcus Brown) join the call to help scope networking.

Attached: reguhealth-kickoff.ics (calendar), initial network notes.

Hi Marta — thanks for booking and for the context. Great to meet you virtually. 

Quick checklist items so we come prepared:
- Can you confirm the attendee roles (security / infra / app owners) and whether Daniel will be the networking owner we should sync with?
- Are there any air-gapped / on-prem constraints we should know about (no outbound traffic, HSM-only keying, etc.)?
- For the kickoff we'll need a point of contact for SOC2 artifacts and a shared secure location for transfer (SFTP or customer GCS/Azure link).

If Apr 6 at 10:00 AM PT is tight for your infra team, we can move the call earlier the same day — I can offer 8:30 AM PT or 11:30 AM PT as alternates.

I've attached our preflight checklist which highlights typical docs we ask for ahead of a Private pilot (network diagram, IP allowlist, SOC2 control owner, data flow diagram). If you can populate that and share it before the call, we can save time.

Thanks — I'll leave Olga in to coordinate ops details and Marissa for CS onboarding questions.

Best,
Aditya Rao
SDR, Redwood Inference

Attachments: preflight-checklist.pdf

- Marta Lopez — Security lead (controls + SOC2)
- Daniel Kim — Infra (networking, VPN) — will be primary for IP allowlist and firewall rules

Hi Marta / team — thanks for the quick responses and for sharing the network summary. 8:30 AM PT on Tue Apr 6 works for our ops and I updated the calendar invite accordingly.

Notes & asks for the kickoff so we can run the session efficiently (agenda below):
1) Agenda (45 min):
   - 5m: Intros + scope of pilot (Priya/Marta)
   - 15m: Networking and connectivity (Daniel + Marcus) — IP ranges, NAT/Egress, VPN if applicable
   - 15m: Deployment model and data controls (Olga/Marissa) — KMS, retention, logs
   - 10m: Next steps, success criteria, evidence handoff (all)

2) Concrete pre-call asks (please try to share before EOD Mon Apr 5):
   - Canonical network diagram (we have your doc but need final IP ranges and any proxy/gateway hops)
   - SOC2 contact and link to the latest SOC2 report or a secure transfer mechanism
   - A single point-of-contact who can approve temporary firewall rules during the pilot

3) Logistics:
   - I'll invite our infra engineer (Karthik Iyer) to the call for any low-level networking questions.
   - Marissa will own the onboarding checklist and follow-up for CS artifacts.

Attachments referenced in thread: reguhealth-kickoff.ics, preflight-checklist.pdf, ReguHealth_network_summary.docx

If anything changes to attendee availability please reply-all — otherwise see you Apr 6 at 8:30 AM PT (updated invite).

Cheers,
